items.html: Know that there are three aspects in Arich Anpin. The first is when his head is corrected — neither erect nor bent. The second is when his head is very erect, for then his beard is raised upward. The third is when he bends his head downward, for then his beard is lowered and descends down to the head of ZA, as will be said below. And then Aba and Ima, whose Keter is from the throat of Arich Anpin, are then included within the head of Arich Anpin literally; and through this is made for them the aspect of Mochin and the aspect of their new NHY.
